content:
Hi all — We recently posted a preprint on autoformalization that might be of interest to those working on NL-to-Lean translation:

Sage: Formalization with Semantic Correction https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.35790

The paper proposes a pipeline that first decomposes natural language statements and generates intermediate pseudo-Lean code before translating into Lean, followed by a joint syntax-semantic correction loop. Equipped with a semantic rater alongside compiler diagnostics, it aims to fix syntax errors and subtle semantic issues simultaneously.

Feedback and comments are very welcome!
(With @Farzad Jafarrahmani @Abdelmouksit SAGUENI, @Xiang ZHOU )
